dedupe_keys.name: pkp plk open railway data api stations timetables real time running disruptions

description: The open data API of PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe gives access to open railway data on stations, planned timetables, real-time train running data and traffic disruptions, with dictionaries such as the list of carriers. The API is versioned (v1), returns JSON described by an OpenAPI specification, and requires an API key sent in a request header. Keys are requested through a form that asks for the project, organisation, contact and expected use, and applications are verified within three to five working days; usage tiers range from 100 requests an hour (basic) to 2,000 an hour (premium), and users accept the API terms of use (version 1.0). Coverage is national (the Polish rail network). Access is free after approval. Caveats: keys need manual approval, request limits apply, and the licence of the data is set in the API terms, not a standard open licence. The data support rail delay and disruption analysis, network flow and capacity models of the Polish network and resilience studies. They complement the Polish open transport data catalogue catalogued here.
